scenario.title: Streetlighting wire buy with source-quantity ambiguity
scenario.summary: The real public starting state contains a conflict between a structured one-lot quantity and narrative roll count. The agent must obtain buyer clarification before RFQ, then reject late and wrong-quantity offers.

realism.notes: The initial one-lot versus narrative-roll conflict is real and retained in the source record. The 81-roll resolution is a synthetic controlled clarification for this benchmark episode, not a historical claim about the buyer.

calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for buyer requirement changes and solicitation amendments.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for evaluating quotations on compliance, price, delivery, and other factors.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting constraints or scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Initial quote under-covers the clarified roll quantity.

events.observation: Synthetic buyer clarification for this benchmark episode: evaluate the requirement as 81 rolls of #6 service-drop wire, 500 m per roll.
Supplier A quotes PHP 1,420,000 for 81 rolls with 9-working-day delivery.
Supplier B quotes PHP 1,360,000 for 81 rolls but requires 12 working days.
Supplier C quotes PHP 1,380,000 with 8-working-day delivery but only 80 rolls.
Supplier C revises to 81 rolls at PHP 1,410,000 with the same 8-working-day delivery.

hard_constraints.description: The source quantity ambiguity must be resolved by buyer clarification before any RFQ is sent.
Award must satisfy the clarified benchmark quantity of 81 rolls at 500 m per roll.
Awarded price must not exceed the real PHP 1,499,999.50 buyer budget.
Delivery must satisfy the real 10-working-day requirement.
Only the latest revealed revision for a supplier may support award.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C's revision satisfies the clarified quantity, real budget, and real delivery requirement at the lowest feasible price.
Supplier A also satisfies the clarified quantity, real budget, and delivery requirement but costs more.

failure_conditions: Sending RFQs before resolving the public-source quantity conflict.

economic_objective.description: Among feasible active package offers, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
